newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 91-day t-bill average yield 6.466 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 91-day t-bill average yield 6.466 pct.

text.p: Bank Negara Malaysia said on Friday it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.466 percent at its auction of 91-day treasury bills for 80 million ringgit.
At its previous auction of 91-day treasury bills on April 17 for a similar amount, the average yield was 6.481 percent.
The bids accepted were in a high/low range of 6.480/445 percent against 6.528/439 percent previously.
The central bank said it accepted bids for 182-day treasury bills of 100 million ringgit at an average 6.469 percent against 6.474 percent on April 17.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.483/440 percent against 6.500/439 percent previously.
Bank Negara said it will hold the next auction of 364-day treasury bills for 100 million ringgit on May 9.
